source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将破，静压将裂
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC26 after EP02 SC25 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the near-breakpoint into the next escalation: Keshadu is almost ready to force the hidden truth into the open, Shisilang's instability keeps the surface volatile, Tuobaye is still trapped without a clear path, and the white-clothed woman's restraint feels ready to crack into action.
title: 真相将破，静压将裂

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC25 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC25 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 试探再紧，十四郎情绪更乱，白衣女子的静压几乎要裂开。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这条压抑线继续推向临界点。科沙度对隐藏援手的判断已经接近摊牌，十四郎的不稳会让局面更危险，拓拔野则被迫在完全不知底牌的情况下继续硬撑。白衣女子的克制会进一步逼近动作发生的边缘。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把压力从近乎揭穿推到真正不可继续压住的程度，为后面更直接的爆点做最后蓄力。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant, restrained, and dangerous; no overt spell spectacle yet.
Keshadu is nearly certain and should feel closer than ever to exposing the hidden line.
Shisilang remains unstable from pride and humiliation, not calm or dignified.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.
